author: Bellular News
description:
Saber Interactive's next game is Rideshare Stimulator, a taxi sim where you chat with your passengers. The Steam page now admits the voices are AI. Some of the radio too. There's even a mode that generates the missions. Writer Stella Sacco says ChatGPT replaced her on it nearly three years ago. CEO Matt Karch says that never happened... but adds he'd have been happy to. And as if this story wasn't insane enough, somehow, it beings with Randy Pitchford and a missing USB drive.
